cards.example_en: A bee attack sent the campers running indoors.
cards.example_zh: 蜜蜂突然袭击，露营的人全跑进了屋里。
cards.explain_zh: 动词直接接宾语；名词常用an attack on。
cards.source: Word Atlas; existing QuizMario bilingual correction

cards.example_en: My sister enjoys learning foreign languages in her spare time.
cards.example_zh: 我姐姐喜欢在空闲时间学习外语。
cards.explain_zh: foreign to可指对某人陌生，或与某事不相符。

cards.example_en: Foreign investment can create jobs, but governments should ensure that local communities also benefit from economic growth.
cards.example_zh: 外国投资可以创造就业机会，但政府应确保当地社区也能从经济增长中受益。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Finding a birthday cake in the kitchen was a lovely surprise.
cards.example_zh: 在厨房里发现一个生日蛋糕，真是个美好的惊喜。
cards.explain_zh: 人感到惊讶用surprised；事物令人惊讶用surprising。

cards.example_en: My favourite feature of this backpack is its hidden pocket.
cards.example_zh: 这个背包最让我喜欢的特点是它的隐藏口袋。
cards.explain_zh: 作动词时直接接宾语，不说feature with。

cards.example_en: We found a pretty cottage beside a quiet stream.
cards.example_zh: 我们在一条安静的小溪边发现了一座漂亮的小屋。
cards.explain_zh: 作副词表示“相当”时偏口语，正式写作可用fairly。

cards.example_en: We recently moved into a flat near the river.
cards.example_zh: 我们最近搬进了河边的一套公寓。
cards.explain_zh: 可用于一般过去时或现在完成时，不只限于完成时。

cards.example_en: Too much coffee can affect how well you sleep.
cards.example_zh: 喝太多咖啡会影响你的睡眠质量。
cards.explain_zh: 表示“影响”时affect是动词，effect通常是名词。

cards.example_en: If public transport becomes more reliable, the number of people driving to work may drop significantly.
cards.example_zh: 如果公共交通变得更可靠，开车上班的人数可能会显著下降。
cards.explain_zh: drop by表示下降了多少；drop to表示降至多少。

cards.example_en: Have you seen any recent photos of our puppy?
cards.example_zh: 你看过我们家小狗最近的照片吗？
cards.explain_zh: recent是形容词；修饰动作要用recently。

cards.example_en: I can relate to your fear of flying.
cards.example_zh: 我能理解你对坐飞机的恐惧。
cards.explain_zh: relate to可指“与……有关”，也可指“产生共鸣”。

cards.example_en: I can relate to your fear of flying.
cards.example_zh: 我能理解你对坐飞机的恐惧。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We checked the official website before booking our tickets.
cards.example_zh: 我们订票前查看了官方网站。
cards.explain_zh: official强调官方认可；formal强调形式或场合正式。

cards.example_en: We asked for financial advice before buying our first home.
cards.example_zh: 购买第一套住房前，我们咨询了理财建议。
cards.explain_zh: financial侧重金钱与财务；economic侧重经济整体。

cards.example_en: Hurry up, or we will miss the last bus.
cards.example_zh: 快点，否则我们会错过末班公交车。
cards.explain_zh: miss后接名词或动名词，不接to do。

cards.example_en: We spent the afternoon making art with coloured paper.
cards.example_zh: 我们花了一下午用彩纸创作艺术作品。
cards.explain_zh: art指艺术通常不可数；一件作品用a work of art。

cards.meaning_zh: 有组织的运动；宣传活动
cards.example_en: Our school launched a campaign to reduce food waste.
cards.example_zh: 我们学校发起了一项减少食物浪费的活动。
cards.explain_zh: 动词后接for表示争取，接against表示反对。

cards.example_en: Each guest has a private bathroom beside their bedroom.
cards.example_zh: 每位客人的卧室旁都有一间专用浴室。
cards.explain_zh: in private表示私下地；in public表示公开地。

cards.example_en: Teachers should pause after asking questions to give students enough time to develop their answers.
cards.example_zh: 教师提问后应稍作停顿，让学生有足够的时间组织答案。
cards.explain_zh: pause指暂时停下，通常暗示还会继续。

cards.example_en: Everyone brought a dish to share at the picnic.
cards.example_zh: 每个人都带了一道菜，在野餐时一起分享。
cards.explain_zh: everyone接单数谓语；every one强调逐个。

cards.example_en: I always forget where I put my reading glasses.
cards.example_zh: 我总是忘记把老花镜放在哪里了。
cards.explain_zh: forget to do忘记去做；forget doing忘记做过。

cards.example_en: The answer key is on the last page of the workbook.
cards.example_zh: 参考答案在练习册的最后一页。

cards.example_en: I worry about my cat when she stays outside.
cards.example_zh: 猫待在外面时，我会担心她。
cards.explain_zh: worry about表示担心某事；worried描述人的状态。

cards.example_en: I worry about my cat when she stays outside.
cards.example_zh: 猫待在外面时，我会担心她。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We often eat outside during the long summer evenings.
cards.example_zh: 夏天傍晚很长，我们常在户外吃饭。
cards.explain_zh: 泛指夏季可用in summer；季节名称通常小写。

cards.example_en: I always drink some water after walking the dog.
cards.example_zh: 我遛完狗总会喝些水。
cards.explain_zh: 不规则变化：drink—drank—drunk。

cards.example_en: Encouraging children to drink water instead of sugary beverages may improve their dental health over time.
cards.example_zh: 鼓励儿童喝水而非含糖饮料，长远来看可能改善他们的牙齿健康。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: What is your opinion of our new kitchen?
cards.example_zh: 你觉得我们的新厨房怎么样？
cards.explain_zh: 表达“在我看来”用in my opinion，不用according to me。

cards.example_en: In my opinion, public transport should be affordable enough to encourage people to leave their cars at home.
cards.example_zh: 在我看来，公共交通的价格应足够实惠，从而鼓励人们不开私家车出门。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We shared a picnic under the trees in the park.
cards.example_zh: 我们在公园的树下共进了野餐。
cards.explain_zh: 公园用park；英式英语中停车场用car park。

cards.example_en: My classmates chose me to represent them at the meeting.
cards.example_zh: 同学们选我代表他们参加会议。
cards.explain_zh: represent是动词；on behalf of是“代表”的介词短语。

cards.example_en: I left my house key in my coat pocket.
cards.example_zh: 我把家门钥匙放在外套口袋里了。
cards.explain_zh: the key to中to是介词，后接名词或动名词。

cards.example_en: Your keys are inside the small pocket of your bag.
cards.example_zh: 你的钥匙在包的小口袋里。
cards.explain_zh: inside后接名词时是介词；单独用可作副词。

cards.example_en: The manager helped a new employee arrange the shelves.
cards.example_zh: 经理帮一位新员工整理了货架。
cards.explain_zh: manager指管理者；management可指管理工作或管理层。

cards.example_en: My sister is taking an international flight tomorrow morning.
cards.example_zh: 我姐姐明天早上要乘坐国际航班。
cards.explain_zh: international涉及多国；domestic指国内的。

cards.example_en: International cooperation is essential for tackling environmental problems that extend beyond the borders of individual countries.
cards.example_zh: 国际合作对于解决超越单个国家边界的环境问题至关重要。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Processed foods often contain large amounts of salt, which can contribute to serious health problems.
cards.example_zh: 加工食品往往含有大量盐分，可能导致严重的健康问题。
cards.explain_zh: 及物动词，直接接宾语；表示“含有”时通常不用进行时。

cards.example_en: Did you notice the tiny bird outside our window?
cards.example_zh: 你注意到窗外那只小鸟了吗？
cards.explain_zh: notice sb do强调全过程；notice sb doing强调正在发生。

cards.example_en: I wonder why the cat keeps watching that cupboard.
cards.example_zh: 我想知道那只猫为什么一直盯着那个橱柜。
cards.explain_zh: wonder后接疑问词从句时，用陈述语序。

cards.example_en: Many parents wonder whether online lessons can provide the same social benefits as classroom learning.
cards.example_zh: 许多家长想知道，线上课程能否提供与课堂学习相同的社交益处。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Camping helps us enjoy nature away from busy streets.
cards.example_zh: 露营让我们远离繁忙的街道，享受大自然。
cards.explain_zh: 指大自然时通常不加the；某事的性质用the nature of。

cards.example_en: Understanding the nature of urban poverty is essential for developing policies that address its underlying causes.
cards.example_zh: 了解城市贫困的本质，对制定解决其根本原因的政策至关重要。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The model shows the structure of a wooden bridge.
cards.example_zh: 这个模型展示了一座木桥的结构。
cards.explain_zh: structure既可作名词，也可作动词表示组织、安排。

cards.example_en: You'll find fresh bread in the bakery section.
cards.example_zh: 你可以在烘焙区找到新鲜面包。
cards.explain_zh: section可指文章章节，也可指商店等场所的区域。

cards.example_en: The final section of the report examines how urban design can encourage healthier lifestyles.
cards.example_zh: 报告的最后一部分探讨了城市设计如何促进更健康的生活方式。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: I made myself a sandwich before the walk.
cards.example_zh: 散步前，我给自己做了个三明治。
cards.explain_zh: by myself表示独自或独立；不能用myself代替主语I。

cards.example_en: This jacket is exactly the colour I wanted.
cards.example_zh: 这件夹克正是我想要的颜色。
cards.explain_zh: not exactly常表示并非完全，也可委婉否定。

cards.example_en: This little plant needs more sunlight and less water.
cards.example_zh: 这株小植物需要更多阳光和更少的水。
cards.explain_zh: plant可指植物或工厂；作动词时常表示种植。

cards.example_en: There is blue paint all over your hands.
cards.example_zh: 你的双手沾满了蓝色颜料。
cards.explain_zh: paint多指用颜料画；draw多指用铅笔等画线条。

cards.example_en: A worker in orange overalls repaired the broken fence.
cards.example_zh: 一名穿橙色工作服的工人修好了破损的围栏。
cards.explain_zh: 不只指体力劳动者，也可指医护等职业工作者。

word.example_en: Official statistics indicate that investment in public transport has increased steadily over the past decade.
word.example_zh: 官方统计数据显示，过去十年公共交通投资持续增长。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

word.example_en: Governments should provide financial support for small businesses that create jobs in economically disadvantaged communities.
word.example_zh: 政府应为在经济困难社区创造就业机会的小企业提供资金支持。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

word.example_en: My sister is taking an international flight tomorrow morning.
word.example_zh: 我姐姐明天早上要乘坐国际航班。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0
